_doc: Every formula and coefficient the Health pages compute with. The Kotlin only evaluates these shapes (HealthFormulas); changing a constant here changes the app, so each one carries its source.

anthropometrics._doc: LBM = mass * (1 - bf/100); FFMI = LBM / height_m^2; BMR = base + per_lbm * LBM (Katch-McArdle form); TDEE = BMR * the selected activity multiplier.

thermal._doc: Sauna sodium chloride loss per minute (owner's protocol constant); sodium is 39.34 % of NaCl by mass; fluid to replace is 150 % of the mass lost (1 kg = 1 L).

hemodynamics._doc: Splanchnic (gut) blood flow as % of resting against exertion as % of VO2max: a piecewise-linear reference from the exercise-physiology literature (Rowell). A meal inside min_gap_min of training, or a fatty one inside fat_gap_min, is flagged.

circadian._doc: Cortisol reference points (minutes after midnight, nmol/L) of the owner's plan; the curve is interpolated linearly and wraps at 24 h.

sleep._doc: Health Connect sleep stage codes drawn on Recovery > Sleep.
